tools.name: search_findings
tools.description: Find dated findings about code export, GitHub sync, backend connections and databases for Bubble, Lovable, Base44 and Replit. Use this to discover record IDs; get_finding retrieves one exact record. Other topics return no matches, not a product verdict.

tools.name: get_finding
tools.description: Retrieve one exact finding using a record ID returned by search_findings or compare_products. Returns the published answer, scope, original dates, conditions, limits, source links and dataset attribution.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare 2–4 covered app builders on the released code, GitHub, backend and database questions. Specify capability IDs from coverage or search results, or omit them for all four questions. Preserves separate dates and unknowns; provides no overall ranking.
